name: load_track
description: Load a local GPX, FIT, TCX or KML file into the workspace. Each imported item accepts at most 100,000 points including attached waypoints; oversized items reject the whole file. Returns a file ID and its item IDs. Reopening a loaded path selects the existing import and restores visibility without rereading it. IDs live for this server process.

name: list_tracks
description: List loaded filenames, paths, item IDs, visibility and the active item.

name: unload_track
description: Remove a loaded file and all of its items from this server's workspace.

name: summarize_track
description: Summarize a whole file, or one item when item_id is supplied, without connecting gaps.

name: inspect_track
description: Inspect by zero-based index or nearest recorded distance_m. Supply exactly one selector. With item_id, indices and distances are local to that item; otherwise they refer to the combined file.

name: select_item
description: Select an item and reveal it if hidden. Workspace renders highlight this item.

name: set_item_visibility
description: Show or hide an item, or the entire file when item_id is omitted. Hiding the active item clears selection. Showing data alone does not select it.

name: remove_item
description: Remove one item from a loaded file. Removing its last item also unloads the file.

name: render_map
description: Render plain terminal text and scene metadata. Set workspace true to fit all visible items and highlight the active item; omit track_id, item_id and point_index in that mode. Otherwise render track_id (optionally item_id), or omit track_id for the basemap alone. Defaults to Mapbox when configured, otherwise an empty canvas. Online rendering requires prior billing-risk acknowledgement and offline mode disabled; otherwise returns an actionable error. Use provider none for local rendering without acknowledgement. Missing credentials appear in scene status. Negative zoom permits wide extents in small viewports. Width/height are map cells.
